Docker Hub setup for "apollo-gateway" succeeded and the CI credentials are available on fd 3. Show me exactly the commands to set the two GitHub Actions secrets on vezril/apollo-gateway, then how to verify.

```zsh
IFS= read -r -u 3 DH_USER
IFS= read -r -u 3 DH_TOKEN

printf %s "$DH_USER"  | gh secret set DOCKERHUB_USERNAME --repo vezril/apollo-gateway
printf %s "$DH_TOKEN" | gh secret set DOCKERHUB_TOKEN    --repo vezril/apollo-gateway

unset DH_USER DH_TOKEN
```

Piping to stdin keeps the values out of argv and shell history. Don't use `--body`.

